mapper.sql: n.id, n.tenant_id, n.notice_title, n.notice_type, n.cover_file_id, n.notice_summary, n.sort_no, n.publish_locations, n.approve_status, n.release_status, n.process_instance_id, n.status, n.remark, n.created_by, n.created_at, n.updated_by, n.updated_at, n.deleted

n.id, n.tenant_id, n.notice_title, n.notice_type, n.cover_file_id, n.notice_content, n.notice_summary, n.sort_no, n.publish_locations, n.approve_status, n.process_instance_id, n.process_definition_key, n.starter_user_id, n.submitted_at, n.finished_at, n.release_status, n.published_at, n.status, n.remark, n.created_by, n.created_at, n.updated_by, n.updated_at, n.deleted
FROM sys_notice n LEFT JOIN infra_file f ON f.id = n.cover_file_id AND f.deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT , f.file_url AS cover_preview_url
WHERE n.id = #{id} AND n.deleted = 0

SELECT , f.file_url AS cover_preview_url
ORDER BY n.sort_no ASC, n.created_at DESC

SELECT , f.file_url AS cover_preview_url
WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status = '0' AND n.approve_status = 'approved' AND n.release_status = 'published' AND (n.tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR n.tenant_id = '0') AND FIND_IN_SET(#{publishLocation}, n.publish_locations) ORDER BY n.sort_no ASC, n.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , f.file_url AS cover_preview_url
WHERE n.id = #{id} AND n.deleted = 0 AND n.approve_status = 'approved' AND n.release_status = 'published' AND (n.tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR n.tenant_id = '0')

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_notice n WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status = '0' AND n.approve_status = 'approved' AND n.release_status = 'published' AND (n.tenant_id = #{tenantId} OR n.tenant_id = '0') AND ( n.cover_file_id = #{fileId} OR n.notice_content LIKE concat('%/infra/file/', #{fileId}, '/download%') )

SELECT process_instance_id FROM sys_notice WHERE deleted = 0 AND approve_status = 'running' AND process_instance_id IS NOT NULL AND process_instance_id != '' AND ( cover_file_id = #{fileId} OR notice_content LIKE concat('%/infra/file/', #{fileId}, '/download%') OR notice_content LIKE concat('%/system/notice/content-file/', #{fileId}, '/download%') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_notice ( id, tenant_id, notice_title, notice_type, cover_file_id, notice_content, notice_summary, sort_no, publish_locations, approve_status, process_instance_id, process_definition_key, starter_user_id, submitted_at, finished_at, release_status, published_at, status, remark, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tenantId}, #{noticeTitle}, #{noticeType}, #{coverFileId}, #{noticeContent}, #{noticeSummary}, #{sortNo}, #{publishLocations}, #{approveStatus}, #{processInstanceId}, #{processDefinitionKey}, #{starterUserId}, #{submittedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{releaseStatus}, #{publishedAt}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{deleted} )
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_notice SET approve_status = #{approveStatus}, process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE sys_notice SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
